messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'ultraex-enterprise' GPU utilization 98% and growing. Inflight queueing >5m. Autoscale did not trigger (policy: manual-burst required). Paging on-call.
aneesh: Taking ownership — I'm oncall. @tyler @elaine tagging you for visibility.
tyler: Pulling metrics now — queue length ~120, avg service time 2.4s, backpressure alarms firing.
maria: Support note: UltraEx reports 5xx errors from their agent in the last 10m (ticket #4231). They see timeouts, asking for ETA.
elaine: Do not evict anything — this is single-tenant dedicated. Can we do an emergency burst from reserved capacity?
aneesh: Checked autoscale logs: burst eligibility blocked by billing hold flag on the tenant profile. Hitting billing API error 402.
aneesh: Quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-critical background/batch routes for this pool, 2) enable quantized fallback model on interactive endpoints to reduce GPU pressure.
tyler: Preparing route patch to rate-limit `routes/ultraex.json` and enable model alias `gptx-q` as fallback. Pushing now.
incident-bot: Canary deploy started: quantized model v1-q on 2 nodes in pool. Monitoring token cost and latency.
maria: Liaison updated UltraEx engineering lead — they can tolerate a 5-10% latency increase but cannot have increased error rates.
elaine: Decision: Approve emergency burst of +4 GPUs from reserved pool for 30 minutes. I'll sign emergency billing approval. :thumbsup:
aneesh: Executing allocation: `infra-cli allocate --pool reserved --count 4 --tenant ultraex --reason "live mitigation"`
aneesh: Allocation confirmed on hosts gke-serve-06..09. Starting gradual traffic shift to new nodes.
tyler: Traffic shifted ~60% to new nodes. Queue dropped to ~10, tail latency steady ~2.8s. No new 5xx observed.
maria: Support notified customer: we see errors resolved, small latency increase. Customer acknowledged and is monitoring.
elaine: Follow-ups assigned: (A) remove billing hold permanently, (B) root-cause why autoscale blocked by billing flags, (C) add automated quantized fallback when queue >50, (D) postmortem.
aneesh: Opening incident and assigning owners: ENG-RUNTIME for autoscale policy bug, SRE for runbook and playbook updates.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-ULTRAEX-001 by aneesh. Severity: Sev2. Handoff to on-call for postmortem and RCA.
